identity.rule: Every generation references the AUTHORED SHEET, never a previous frame. Drift compounds; a variation of a variation is a cousin.

reuse.crop: crop the named shot; never regenerate
reuse.edit: edit the named shot conditioned on the sheet; never regenerate

acceptance.skin: never lighter than the approved model sheet (see LOCK.SKIN.POLICY)
reject_if: camera moves on a locked shot
